note: Each fighter's epithet, weapon, and a surfaced archive fact are grounded in the Early Greece chapter (ch08). 'basis' must appear in ch08 (checked by tools/verify-fighters.js, which also requires a non-empty 'fact'). fighter.js loads this file and shows the fact + source link on the select and victory screens (D4). Move-set/animation is game design; the god, weapon, epithet, and fact are drawn from real myth as the chapter records it.

fighters.name: Zeus
fighters.basis: Zeus became king of a new order
fighters.fact: Zeus overthrew the Titans and became king of a new order, the Olympians — marked in Greek art by his thunderbolt and eagle.

fighters.name: Poseidon
fighters.fact: Poseidon, lord of the sea with his trident, is among the oldest attested Greek gods — written po-se-da-o in Bronze Age Linear B.

fighters.name: Athena
fighters.fact: Athena, goddess of wisdom and war, is identified in art by her owl, aegis, and olive.

fighters.name: Hades
fighters.fact: The dead crossed the river Styx to the realm of Hades — a dim, strengthless existence, early Greece as bleak on death as Mesopotamia.
